items.title: Free Greek Key Oval Medallion DXF Panel for CNC Doors
items.description: A restrained Greek key border frames a single oval medallion built from layered floral scrollwork, leaving generous open black space around it. The minimal composition puts all the visual weight on the medallion, making this one of the more understated, gallery-ready designs in the set.
